edits.old: Then the retried activity creates no second case and no second link
edits.new:
Then the retried activity creates no second case and no second link

  Scenario: AC21 A consumed call fails or does not answer (exception on a provider contract)
    Given rwb-source-data does not answer the ALS batch call for 2026-12-01 within the 2 s client budget, or returns status 503, through its contract
    When AceDataReady is raised for ALS and 2026-12-01 and JOB-02 runs
    Then the system creates no case from a partial read for 2026-12-01
    Then the job record carries the failed call and its attempt
    Then the accounts are read again on the next complete ALS batch

  Scenario: AC22 A case status change the status model does not allow is refused (case status model)
    Given case RW-2026-000123 has status "NEW"
    When a status change to a value the case status model does not allow is requested for case RW-2026-000123
    Then the system refuses the change and case RW-2026-000123 keeps status "NEW"
    Then no event is published for the refused change
